title: Auto-Dig request #1897 North Greenbush vendor-resolution pass
summary: Queue-first request pass reuses the existing North Greenbush target and resolves Flock as the independently reported vendor while preserving unresolved procurement, equipment, administrator, audit, and sharing questions.

sources.title: Town of North Greenbush Police Department
Residents question proposal for automatic license plate reader at Poestenkill intersection

data.research_question: What portion of request #1897 can be resolved now without duplicating existing StarIntel identities?
data.method: Read the request and comments, searched current main for the North Greenbush target, reused `starintel:investigation-target:north-greenbush-vendor-resolution`, reviewed current town/police public surfaces, and reconciled November 2025 ALPR reporting with March 2026 Flock-specific reporting.
classification_rules: Reuse stable canonical IDs when materially equivalent records already exist.
Vendor resolution does not establish ownership, contract terms, camera inventory, sharing, or actual use.

findings.finding: The existing North Greenbush vendor-resolution target is canonical and was reused rather than duplicated.
March 2026 independent reporting resolves Flock Safety as the reported current ALPR vendor.
Primary procurement, equipment, ownership, administration, audit, and sharing evidence remains incomplete.
